sectors.name: Technology
themes: Indonesia's accelerating digital economy—e-commerce, fintech, and cloud adoption—is driving structural revenue growth for local tech platforms, independent of global macro swings.
AI and data-center buildout in Southeast Asia, including hyperscaler investments in Batam and Jakarta, creates durable demand for Indonesian tech infrastructure and connectivity providers.
Global semiconductor upcycle, led by memory and AI accelerators, benefits Indonesian-listed tech via supply-chain linkages and rising regional tech sentiment, amplifying local beta.
sectors.ai: Buy Indonesia tech exposure into strength: local names (MLPT, IRSX, PMUI) are outperforming US peers on domestic digitalization and AI-driven data-center capex, while global semis (Samsung, SK Hynix, SoftBank) confirm a sustained memory/AI cycle. Rotate from laggards to leaders with earnings momentum; hold through Q3 volatility as IDX tech liquidity improves.

FPNI and ALKA are speculative spikes—take profits, not fresh risk. Hold AGII for coal export resilience. Watch US dollar strength as the only near-term brake; trim if DXY breaks 104.5.
